capabilities_enforced.agentContainer: internal-only run network; reachable endpoints: gateway:8811 (Bearer auth) and llm-proxy:3128 (CONNECT allowlist: token-plan.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com:443); no workspace, output, or docker-socket mounts; model API key present by necessity
capabilities_enforced.containers: the llm proxy, the gateway, the probe, the agent: all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, memory 2g, cpus 1, pids 512; the gateway keeps DAC_READ_SEARCH alone, to read the run's secrets file; read-only root: the llm proxy, the probe, the agent (tmpfs /tmp, /work, /home/docker-agent); the tool and MCP server containers the gateway launches get the same memory and cpus through its flags and the no-new-privileges its documentation gives them, their capabilities and root as it leaves them
capabilities_enforced.daemon: the gateway reaches the docker daemon only through this run's filter: every container, network and volume it creates carries the run's label, it may touch no container, network, volume or exec without it (the pinned gateway's shared relay networks excepted, DR-22; only its digest-pinned relays join the one that leaves the host), lists and events show only the run's, create bodies are checked as the daemon reads them, and it may not create a privileged, host-namespace, device, port-publishing, runtime-choosing or security-weakened container, bind a host path outside the run's directories or write outside its writable ones, or exceed the run's memory, CPU and process limits; every decision is in receipts/docker-filter.log
capabilities_enforced.dataAccess: declared files; no servers cataloged by policy (declaration recorded for audit)
capabilities_enforced.decode: the inputs were decoded before the run, in agentry-runner-exec:c0c505707efb6-f6d817cb3b87 with no network, every capability dropped and the inputs read-only, by pandoc, pdftotext and tesseract (pandoc-cli-3.6.4-r0, poppler-utils-25.04.0-r0, tesseract-ocr-5.5.0-r2, tesseract-ocr-data-eng-5.5.0-r2) and the runner's own PPTX and XLSX reader: 0 decoded, 6 read as text
capabilities_enforced.exec: no exec: run_command tool not exposed; harness built-in shell toolsets never enabled
capabilities_enforced.filesystem: read none; write none — enforced by the tools-container mount table (ro/rw, per-path binds) plus server-side grant checks
capabilities_enforced.model.apiKey: $OPENAI_API_KEY from the host environment, injected into the agent container (or the host harness process) only
capabilities_enforced.network: no egress: tools container runs with networking disabled (disableNetwork); no fetch tool exposed

result: Now the carrier, alarm, returns, safety and staffing pages.
